stories.h: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech s AI chip buildout
stories.s: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips.

techmeme.com: Nvidia plans to invest $3.5B into MediaTek through convertible bonds; MediaTek forecasts AI chip revenue of about $2B this year (Bloomberg)
